title: Create a document in AI Write
summary: Writes a new document into the AI Write app on this device with a title and Markdown text, and returns a link that opens it.
whenToUse: Use when the person wants something written up, saved or kept. Put the whole text in one call.
example: Write that up as a document in AI Write
_note: Phase AV.20: 'write' alone was a reason to make a document, so 'Write a haiku' was offered one; now the phrases that mean a write-up.
